description: This file provides classes and functions to support unit-testing of logging code, including capturing log messages, asserting expected messages, and configuring logging for tests.

classes.name: TestLogStream
classes.description: A file-like object for capturing log messages during unit tests.

classes.name: LogTesting
classes.description: Supports end-to-end unit testing of log messages, including setup and assertions.

classes.name: LoggingTestCase
classes.description: A unittest.TestCase subclass that provides methods for testing log output.

methods.name: LogTesting._getLogger
methods.description: Returns the logger being tested (default: root logger).

methods.name: LogTesting.setUp
methods.description: Configures logging for unit testing, redirecting logs to a test stream.

methods.name: LogTesting.tearDown
methods.description: Resets logging by removing the test handler.

methods.name: LogTesting.messages
methods.description: Returns the current list of captured log messages.

methods.name: LogTesting.assertMessages
methods.description: Asserts that the captured log messages match expected messages and clears the message list.

methods.name: LoggingTestCase.set_logging_level
methods.description: Sets the logging level for the test.

methods.name: LoggingTestCase.tearDown
methods.description: Tears down the logging test environment.

methods.name: LoggingTestCase.assertLog
methods.description: Asserts log messages and clears the log message list.
